fusions.name: Hopping Nip
fusions.desc: Spits a nip that deals 4 damage to the first enemy in its path, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage each.

fusions.name: Springing Spurs
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target with a spur-kick that deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Shaken Loose
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and springs you 2 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mites in the Down
fusions.desc: A colony of mites lives in your feathers and leaps onto enemies within 3 tiles, biting for 2 damage every 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
